name: lightcone-reproduction
description: Reproduce a published scientific paper end-to-end in ASTRA. Orchestrates paper extraction, literature resolution, ralph-loop iteration, narrative authoring, figure/numeric comparison, and sentence-by-sentence claim auditing, plus the lc-extractor subagent for prior-insight extraction. Use when reproducing a paper from a DOI, arXiv ID, or PDF, or resuming a reproduction workdir. Builds on lightcone-core + astra.
